items.text:
6. ESTABLISH – NO PARKING ANY TIME, EXCEPT BICYCLES
Sacramento Street, north side, from 172 feet to 192 feet east of Spruce Street (removes stall #3630
for a 17-foot bike corral and 3-foot red zone) (Supervisor District 2) (Approvable by the City Traffic
Engineer) Grant Brokl, [staff email removed — see the order]

Proposal to establish an on-street bicycle corral in an existing general metered parking space on
Sacramento Street.

Public Comments: Comment in opposition concerning parking loss received during public hearing.
Nearby building construction already impacting parking and visitors to medical building rely on driving
and not biking. Suggestion made to place bike corral on other nearby streets and/or postpone
installation until after completion of building construction projects. Received two emails in opposition
after public hearing.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Enginee
